sloka: धक्ष्यामः त्वाम् वयम् वीर श्वभ्रे महति कल्पिते ।स त्वम् सीताम् समाचक्ष्व येन वा यत्र वा हृता ॥३-७१-२५॥
transliteration: dhakṣyāmaḥ tvām vayam vīra śvabhre mahati kalpite ।sa tvam sītām samācakṣva yena vā yatra vā hṛtā ॥3-71-25॥

translations.english: If you really know where SIta has been kidnapped and by whom, tell me. You will be doing a great service.
